strings.(아르케가 앞에 나타난 %s의 얼굴을 보고 놀란다.): (Arche looks surprised to see %s standing before her.)
strings.아르케, 왜 그렇게 놀라요?: Arche, why are you so surprised?
strings.비밀…, 아니고…. 언젠가 다시 이곳에 오실 거라 생각은 했지만, 이렇게: It's a secret... No, I mean... I thought you'd return someday, but not so soon.
I just wanted to come. Once I've visited a place, I tend to come back...
As for how I managed to get here...
strings.(아르케에게 프뉴마에 다시 올 수 있었던 이유를 설명한다.): (You explain to Arche how you were able to return to Pneuma.)
strings.오실 때 별, 문제는 없었나요? 온몸이 찢어질 듯이 아프다거나, 뒤틀린: Did you have any... trouble on the way? Pain like your whole body was being torn apart, or a feeling of twisting out of existence?
strings.잠깐만요, 원래 그렇게 아픈 건가요?: Wait. Is it normally that painful?
strings.가이아 님께서 절 살리기 위해 이곳에 데려오셨을 때, 저는 많이 아팠거든: When Lady Gaia brought me here to save my life, it hurt terribly.
But you seem fine, Adventurer... Perhaps...
strings.역시 여신님들에게 사랑받아서 아픈 게 덜 한 건가 봐요!: It must hurt less because the goddesses love you so much!
After all that thought, that's your answer...?
strings.아, 맞다. 부탁을 드리고 싶은 일이 있는데, 괜찮으세요?: Oh, right. There's something I'd like to ask of you. Is that all right?
Please find an object. Something from the place you came from.
strings.얼마 전, 시공간이 흔들렸을 때 이곳으로 흘러들어온 것 같아요. 찾으려고: It seems to have drifted here when time and space shook recently. I've been trying to find it without any luck.
strings.정령들이 그 물건을 찾다가 이상한 영향을 받으면 이곳은 물론 여신님이 계: If the spirits are affected strangely while searching for it, it could disrupt not only this place but the goddess' realm as well.
I would like you to find it, Adventurer.
strings.지금은 어떤 형태의 물건인지 알 수 없어요. 그래서 모험가님이 알고 있는: I can't tell what form it has now. You'll need to ask the people you know what they've lost.
strings.모험가님이 알아내는 순간, 그 물건은 시간의 영역에서 모습을 드러낼 거예: The moment you discover what it is, it will reveal itself in the Domain of Time.
strings.그건 그렇고, 먼저 어디로 가지…?: But where should I go first...?
strings.이리스 님의 심상세계가 근처에 있으니 그쪽에서 흘러들어오지 않았을까 그런: Lady Iris' Inner World is nearby. I thought it might have drifted in from that direction.
Thank you, %s. Once you learn what it is, go to the domain where Chronos dwells.
strings.(일단 유란 님에게 가서 물어봐야겠다. 루맨을 제일 잘 아는 사람이니까…: (I'll ask Yuran first. She knows Lumen better than anyone...)
strings.오셨습니까? 오랜만에 뵙는군요. 스승님을 도와주신 일에 대해서 감사드립니: You're here. It's been a while. Thank you for helping my master. Thanks to you...
Oh, no. I only did what I should...
You said exactly what Lady Iris did.
strings.그런 건 아니고, 꽃의 정령 조에를 통해 말을 전해왔습니다. 역시 %s: She wasn't. She sent word through Zoe, the flower spirit. You really are no different, %s.
strings.더는 루맨에 볼 일이 없지 않습니까? 외부의 인물이 이제 이스트랜드에서: Surely you have no further business in Lumen? An outsider should have nothing left to do in Eastland.
It isn't Eastland's business. It's personal.
strings.그렇다고 하면 이해해 주실래요?: Would you understand if I said yes?
Then I will cooperate. Go ahead.
strings.네, 혹시 최근 루맨에서 잃어버린 물건을 찾고 있는 사람을 보셨나요?: Have you seen anyone in Lumen searching for something they've lost recently?
strings.막연하군요. 잃어버린 물건이라…. 아. 울이 뭔가 찾고 있을지도 모르겠습: That's vague. Something lost... Ah. Ull may be looking for something. He's up in that tree. You can find him there.
strings.감사합니다. 바로 울에게 가볼게요. 그런데 요즘 울은 괜찮나요? 걱정 많: Thank you. I'll go see Ull. Is he doing all right lately? You were very worried about him.
strings.제가 걱정할 범위는 넘어섰다 생각합니다. 이제 무슨 일이 일어나든 울의: I believe he is beyond what I should worry about. Whatever happens now is his responsibility. We will meet again if my master calls for you.
strings.우리가 따로 인사할 사이는 아닌 것 같은데…. 다시 한번 묻게 만들지 말: I don't think we need formal greetings... Don't make me ask again. Did my senior send you?
strings.아니, 내가 뭐 좀 물어보려고. 최근에 잃어버리거나 찾고 있는 물건 없어: No. I wanted to ask you something. Have you lost anything lately, or been looking for something?
strings.그걸 아무리 찾아도 찾을 수 없던 건 그런 이유였나. 다른 세계로 흘러: So that's why I couldn't find it no matter how hard I looked. It drifted into another world...
strings.내 탓이라 말하고 싶은 거야?: Are you saying it's my fault?
No. It couldn't be helped. I don't think that badly of you.
strings.그래서 네가 찾으러 가는 건가?: So you're going to find it?
If you tell me what it is, I think I can.
You've reached that sort of world already.
In that case, I'll ask you. Find it for me.
strings.그래서 뭘 찾고 있었는데?: So what were you looking for?
strings.다른 대륙의 지도. 연합 본부에 보관되어 있던 건데, 내가 찾아서 보려는: A map of other continents. It was kept at the alliance headquarters. The moment I took it out to examine it, it vanished from my hands.
strings.그걸 왜 보고 있었어?: Why were you looking at it?
You don't need to know. Now go find it.
strings.사람이 바뀌면 금방 죽는다. 그냥 군소리 없이 다녀오는 게 스트레스가 적: They say a sudden change in character means death is near. You'll spare yourself stress if you just go without complaining.
Sigh... Fine. I have to do it anyway...
strings.(울에게 태도 변화란 걸 기대하지 않는 모험가가 루맨을 떠나고, 나무를: (Expecting no improvement in Ull's attitude, the adventurer leaves Lumen. Something enormous climbs the tree and appears before Ull.)
It can't be helped. With a body this size...
strings.문은 찾아봤어?: Did you look for the gate?
All traces of gates from Eastland to the Demon Realm have disappeared.
strings.바이스가 소멸했어도, 마계의 흔적들이 남아있어야 정상일 텐데…? 바이스와: Even with Weiss gone, traces of the Demon Realm should remain... They weren't connected to him anyway...
I suspect it's the same as mine...
strings.네…. 맞습니다. 마계의 누군가가 손을 쓴 것 틀림없습니다. 럭스는 그렇: Yes... Someone in the Demon Realm must have intervened. Lux is one thing, but...
strings.지도를 받는 대로 확인하자. 네가 이야기했던 선조의 땅이란 곳도 가보자고: Let's check as soon as we have the map. We'll visit that ancestral land you mentioned too. That should give us something to work with.
strings.어라, 크로노스. 여기서 기다리고 있었어?: Oh, Chronos. Were you waiting here?
strings.네가 오는 것 같아서 마중 왔다. 아르케 말은 들었지, 부엉?: I sensed you coming and came to meet you. You heard what Arche said, hoot?
I found out what we're looking for.
A map of continents the people of Eastland haven't visited.
strings.그거 어디 있는지 알아?: Do you know where it is?
strings.내가 원래 있던 공간보다 더 깊은 영역까지 흘러들어 간 것 같다. 그곳에: It seems to have drifted deeper than the space I originally occupied. There's a condition you must meet to go there. Hoot.
Oh, come on. Don't tell me... Surely not...
strings.네가 생각하는 그 '설마'가 맞다. 부엉. 날 상대하고 '허락'을 받아야: Yes, exactly what you're thinking. Hoot. You must face me and receive 'permission.' Hoot.
strings.뭘 생각하는지 알고 있어, 부엉. 그곳은 나의 의지보다 강한 의지로 구성: I know what you're thinking. Hoot. That place is formed from a will stronger than my own. Hoot.
strings.(크로노스가 뚱한 표정으로 갑자기 윙크한다.): (Chronos suddenly winks, despite his impassive expression.)
strings.그 앞에서 기다릴 테니까, 날 쓰러뜨려. 부엉. 물론, 쉽게 쓰러지진 않: I'll wait at the entrance. Defeat me. Hoot. And I won't fall easily. Hoot.
strings.(크로노스가 표효를 지르며 하늘 위로 날아오른다.): (Chronos lets out a tremendous cry and flies into the sky.)
strings.저 울음소리는 다시 들어도 적응이 안 되네. 후우, 정신차리고 가볼까?: I still can't get used to that cry. All right, let's focus and go.
strings.날 상대하는 너의 의지에 '허락'이 내려졌어. 부엉. 물건을 가져가도 돼: The will you showed in facing me has been granted 'permission.' Hoot. You may take the object. Hoot.
Crouch down and search the floor. Hoot.
strings.정말 그래도 돼?: Are you sure that's all right?
strings.의심이 많군, 부엉. 주문이라도 외워줄까, 부엉?: So suspicious. Hoot. Would you like me to chant a spell? Hoot.
strings.그거 비슷하긴 한데, 어떻게 알았냐, 부엉?: Something like that. How did you know, hoot?
strings.정령들은 다 비슷하구나. 주문은 괜찮아. 아!: Spirits really are all alike. No need for a spell. Ah!
strings.손에 뭔가 잡혀. 이거다!: I can feel something. This is it!
strings.이건 네가 찾는 그 물건이 맞군. 부엉. 내가 잠깐 봐도 돼, 부엉?: That's indeed the object you're looking for. Hoot. May I see it for a moment, hoot?
strings.이미 들고 있으면서…. 뭐, 확인할 거라도 있어?: You're already holding it... Is there something you want to check?
I want to see which continents it shows. Hoot.
strings.어디 보자, 보자…. 흠. 여기 지엔디아가 있고, 여기 프레이오스가 있고: Let's see, let's see... Hmm. Jiendia here, Freios here, and Creta here—now Eastland. Hoooot.
strings.대륙 몇 개가 더 있는데, 나는 전혀 모르겠네. 여신님의 힘이 닿지 않는: There are several others, but I know nothing about them. The goddess' power doesn't reach them, so no information comes to me. Hoot.
strings.언젠가 신의 심부름꾼이 가서 정보를 확인해야겠지, 부엉?: Someday the gods' emissary will have to go and find out, hoot?
strings.내 영역이 조금 어지러웠는데 안정을 되찾은 것 같다. 이제 하나 남은 거: My domain was a little unsettled, but it seems stable again. One left now? Hoot?
strings.뭐가 또 있는지는 모르겠지만, 물건을 가져다 주고 프뉴마에 다시 와야: I don't know what else there is, but I should return this and come back to Pneuma.
strings.그러면 카이로스를 만나겠군, 부엉. 이제 이 공간엔 외부의 물건이 없다,: Then you'll meet Kairos. Hoot. There are no more foreign objects in this space. Hoot.
Thank you, Chronos. I'll be going.
It was good to see you. Hoot. I should get back to work too. Hoot.
strings.(크로노스가 자리를 박차고 날아가는 가운데, 쓸쓸한 그의 혼잣말이 바람에: (As Chronos takes flight, his lonely muttering drifts back on the wind.)
I want a vacation. Hoot... I want to sleep like Kairos. Hoot...
...Work must be rough. Oh, no time to stand around. Back to Ull.
strings.(울이 %s의 손에 들린 지도를 보고 피식 웃는다.): (Ull gives a faint smile at the map in %s's hand.)
I won't bother acting surprised. It's hardly the first time you've done something like this.
strings.오면서 봤는데, 이 지도엔 다른 대륙도 있네?: I looked on the way back. This map shows other continents too?
strings.그래. 뭐. 지엔디아, 프레이오스, 이스트랜드…. 그리고 몇 개의 다른: Yes. Jiendia, Freios, Eastland... And several others.
strings.전해 내려오는 이름은 테이지스, 나겐, 오트로스 정도로 알고 있는데, 그: The names passed down to us are something like Taegis, Nagen, and Otros. I don't know if they're accurate.
strings.(크로노스에게 정보가 없는 걸 봐서는… 좀 더 이야기를 들어볼까?): (Chronos had no information about them... Should I ask a little more?)
strings.우리가 교류하는 대륙은 프레이오스 정도니까. 자, 이제 가봐. 그런 식으: Freios is the only continent we have much contact with. Now go. You won't get answers by prying like that.
strings.고맙다고. 다시 볼 일이 있을지 모르겠지만, 만약 그럴 일이 있다면 잘: Thank you. I don't know whether we'll meet again, but if we do, I hope we can work together.
strings.(어, 뭐지? 전하고 많이 다른데…. 어디 가는 건가?): (Huh? He's quite different from before... Is he going somewhere?)
strings.아, 아무것도 아니야. 그, 그래…. 나는 다시 갈 곳이 있어서 이만 간: Oh, nothing. R-right... I have somewhere to get back to, so I'll go.
strings.(후우…. 일단, 하나를 찾았으니 다음에 어디로 가야 할지 아르케에게 물: (Whew... That's one found. I should ask Arche where to go next.)
strings.(%s의 모습이 멀어지자 울이 가볍게 기지개를 켠다.): (As %s recedes into the distance, Ull stretches lightly.)
strings.이제 준비해야지. 가기 전에 엘 사저에게 실수한 건 사과해야지. 좀 찜찜: Time to prepare. Before I leave, I should apologize to Ell for that mistake. It's been bothering me.
strings.울, 너 지금 뭐라고 했어?: Ull, what did you just say?
strings.첫째 사저께서 널 불러오라고 하셔서. 나한테 실수한 게 뭔데?: Our eldest senior sent me to fetch you. What mistake did you make?
Tell me, and I'll forgive you right away.
I stepped on the paper dragon you folded. W-wait. Ell...
strings.(안 그래도 차가워 보이는 엘이 굳은 표정으로 울을 바라본다.): (Ell, already cold in demeanor, fixes Ull with a rigid stare.)
strings.베스카, 근처에 있지? 이 놈을 붙잡아!!: Veska, you're nearby, aren't you? Hold him!
V-Veska! I'm your master. Listen to me! Oh, Yuran...
strings.골치 아픈 막내들은 역시 혈기왕성하네? 스승님과 나를 오랫동안 기다리게: Our troublesome juniors are full of energy as ever, I see. Keeping Master and me waiting so long...
strings.스승님께서는 일이 있으시다며 먼저 가셨다. 나중에 스승님께 따로 말씀드리: Master had other business and left ahead of us. You will explain yourselves to him later.
strings.늦게 온건 어쩔 수 없으니 신경 쓰지 않겠다. 그건 그렇고 내가 언제 둘: There's no changing your lateness, so I won't dwell on it. Now, when did I last spar with you two...?
strings.(유란이 좀처럼 보이지 않던 환한 미소를 울과 엘에게 보여준다. 하지만,: (Yuran gives Ull and Ell a radiant smile rarely seen on her face. Yet the broader it grows, the more terrified they become.)
strings.너희들이 뭘 잘못했는데? 난 그저 오랜만에 막내들 솜씨나 보고 싶을 뿐이: What have you done wrong? I simply want to see how our juniors' skills have improved.
strings.금방 검을 가지고 올 테니 어디 가지 말고 기다리고 있거라. 나를 실망시: I'll fetch my sword. Stay right here. You know what happens if you disappoint me, don't you?
strings.(나중에 들려오는 이야기에 의하면 유란의 지시로 한동안 부유섬과 환영의: (Later, word spreads that, by Yuran's order, the Floating Island, Phantom Poison Mist Swamp, and Training Forest are temporarily closed to outside visitors and training.)
